operations.description: Create and deploy one pod from body; a definite 4xx refusal created nothing, and one naming a lack of capacity is refused as capacity, so the workload may be placed elsewhere, while a lost connection or a 5xx after the request was sent leaves the pod possibly created, so check pods.list by name before creating again
List the account's pods in one answer, filtered by the declared query parameters such as name, desiredStatus or id
Read the account's pod billing records in one answer, aggregated by bucketSize and filtered by the declared query parameters such as podId, gpuTypeId or startTime
Terminate one pod by podId; Runpod answers 204, and a 404 means no pod with that id exists, so this call terminated nothing
